name: N3862 Scheduled Inspection — Wexford County Landfill.pdf

The separate '(1)' filename was an exact duplicate and is not carried forward.

name: Wexford County Landfill Tier 2 NMOC Results.pdf

Retesting was due by January 19, 2026.

name: N3862 Renewable Operating Permit Staff Report.pdf

name: Cadillac WWTP CWSRF Project Plan and Funding Proposal.pdf

name: September 8 2009 Special Meeting Minutes.pdf

name: N3862 Scheduled Air Inspection — Wexford County Landfill.pdf
description: June 4, 2024 scheduled air-compliance inspection for Wexford County Landfill registration N3862. It is distinct from the 2017 and 2022 air records already in the library.

name: MPART Citizens Advisory Workgroup Presentation — Cadillac Comparability Study.pdf
description: April 14, 2026 presentation describing Cadillac comparability-study work and public-response status. It is retained as a dated agency presentation, with laboratory records remaining primary evidence.

name: Cadillac Private-Well Location Map — All Data.pdf
description: One-page private-well location map showing the full mapped dataset. It provides response-area context and is not published as a parcel-level analytical conclusion.

name: Cadillac Private-Well Location Map — No Water Main Available.pdf
description: One-page map of private-well locations identified without water-main availability. It is infrastructure-planning context, not proof of contamination at every mapped property.

name: Cadillac Private-Well Location Map — Water Main Available.pdf
description: One-page map of private-well locations identified with water-main availability. It is infrastructure-planning context, not proof of contamination at every mapped property.

name: Michigan FY2025 Active Cleanup Projects Funding Report — First and Second Quarters.pdf
description: Statewide cleanup-project funding report containing Cadillac-area project entries. Funding amounts and statuses are retained as dated program records, not proof that work was completed.

name: Cadillac PFAS Residential Results Summary.pdf
description: One-page residential-results summary from the MPART data package. Values and qualifiers are retained as displayed and should be cross-read with the full result tables.

name: Cadillac PFAS Sample Update — May 29, 2025.pdf
description: Five-page Cadillac sampling update covering response status and current results. It is a dated agency summary and does not replace underlying laboratory reports.

name: EPA Fact Sheet — Wexford Water Technologies Class I Injection Well Permit.pdf
description: EPA Region 5 fact sheet for draft permit MI-165-1I-0002 concerning the proposed Wexford Water Technologies Class I injection well. It is permit-process context, not evidence the well operated.

name: Wexford County Audited Financial Statements — Year Ended December 31, 2024.pdf
description: County audited financial statements containing landfill, water/wastewater and environmental-obligation context. Financial disclosures are retained for governance and funding traceability, not as contaminant measurements.

name: Wexford County Audited Financial Statements — Year Ended December 31, 2018.pdf
description: Audited county financial statements recording the continuing Wexford County Landfill groundwater-remediation obligation after the 2011 sale. Note 9 describes a 2007 MDEQ agreement requiring 30 years of remedial action and operation and maintenance, an $819,916 liability and restricted investments for the obligation. This is financial and governance evidence, not PFAS sampling data or source attribution.

name: Wexford County Board Minutes — Cedar Creek Updates and American Waste Discussion.pdf
description: April 5, 2017 Wexford County Board minutes. In public comment, the Cedar Creek Township treasurer stated that the township was not receiving updates or documents from Infrastructure, referred to RAP-area discussion and asked that Cedar Creek be included in the American Waste discussion concerning the County's yearly fee. The minutes say the matter would be looked into; they do not establish that a legal notice was missed or document a completed response.

name: 2026–2031 Capital Improvement Program — Initial Draft.pdf
description: Initial draft of Cadillac's 2026–2031 Capital Improvement Program. The water and wastewater section identifies proposed work involving sewer lining, lift stations, anaerobic-digester cleaning, laboratory fume hoods, headworks, ultraviolet disinfection, screening, grit removal, filters, sewer inspection equipment and related infrastructure. The document is planning evidence; it does not by itself establish approval, funding, procurement or completed construction.

name: Sources By SRN.pdf
description: Michigan air-source master list revised December 8, 2024 and sorted by source registration number (SRN). Cadillac-area entries include Western Concrete (N0358), Wexford County Landfill (N3862), AAR Mobility Systems and Hutchinson facilities. It is retained as a registry snapshot and locator, not evidence that any listed facility used or released PFAS.

name: Michigan Court of Appeals — County of Wexford v City of Cadillac, No. 205933.pdf
description: July 2, 1999 unpublished Michigan Court of Appeals opinion affirming the trial court's interpretation of the 1977 wastewater-treatment agreement between Wexford County and Cadillac. The opinion states that Cadillac was required to accept wastewater from service districts 1–5 and part of district 11 within the facilities-plan scope, subject to the agreement's negotiated 360,000-gallon limit.

name: Michigan Court of Appeals — Haring, Selma and Clam Lake v City of Cadillac, Nos. 292122 and 292164.pdf
description: Michigan Court of Appeals opinion issued October 12, 2010 and approved for publication November 23, 2010. It affirms that Cadillac's 1977 and 1980 wastewater-service contracts with the townships expire on May 12, 2017 and do not impose a continuing service duty beyond that contractual date.

name: Michigan Court of Appeals — Haring Charter Township v City of Cadillac, No. 299683.pdf
description: August 23, 2012 unpublished Michigan Court of Appeals opinion affirming the order that Cadillac sell Haring Township 0.121 MGD of wastewater-treatment capacity under the 1980 contract. It also affirms the contract's service-area boundary interpretation.

name: EPA April 1977 Wastewater Treatment Construction Grant Awards.pdf
description: EPA's April 1977 monthly construction-grant register. PDF page 68 records a $4,719,150 continuation award to the City of Cadillac on April 29, 1977 for treatment-works construction under grant 262523-03-0, with an eligible project cost of $6,292,200.

name: EPA Operation and Maintenance of Publicly Owned Treatment Works Conference Proceedings.pdf
description: December 1983 EPA proceedings from the January 1982 national POTW operations conference. Paper 16 includes Cadillac among eight Michigan energy-audit sites, identifies a 2.0 MGD design capacity and 10,200-person service area, reports electricity and natural-gas shares, and reproduces a March 1976–September 1978 operating-data summary. It is historical operating context, not PFAS source evidence.

name: Cadillac WWTP Tertiary Filter Pipe Replacement.pdf
description: June 16, 2025 council communication and Monarch Welding proposal concerning leakage at the pipe penetrations of all three AquaDisc tertiary filters. Plant staff called the repair urgent and recommended an $11,137 award; the packet is a recommendation and proposal, not proof of council approval or completed installation.

name: Michigan FY2018 State Revolving Fund Annual Report.pdf
description: Michigan's FY2018 State Revolving Fund annual report. The funded-project tables record Cadillac project 5277-01, described as WWTP/pump-station improvements in Wexford County, with an August 30, 2007 binding commitment of $3,870,000. It is official funding context and not a contaminant result.

name: Updated Well Record — 1140 Plett Road.pdf
description: Owner-provided May 6, 2026 compilation for the private well at 1140 Plett Road. It records a reported 70-foot casing depth, 68.5-foot below-ground depth and 10-foot static-water level, with a construction sketch and historical-source notes. The page expressly states that it is not a driller-certified well-completion log or an official agency record; it is retained as secondary well context, not as a licensed-professional determination.

name: Property Measurement Photo Set — 1140 Plett Road.pdf
description: One-page image-only collage of six owner-provided photographs associated by the archive classification index with driveway and well-head measurement context at 1140 Plett Road. The PDF metadata identifies the file as driveway_collage_8.5x11 and records a May 6, 2026 creation date. The photographs are preserved as secondary property context; they are not treated as a survey, a licensed well record, measured coordinates or proof of environmental conditions.

name: FY2017 City of Cadillac Comprehensive Annual Financial Report.pdf
description: City of Cadillac comprehensive annual financial report for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2017. Page 19 of the printed report (PDF page 25) states that revenue for treating Wexford County Landfill leachate exceeded budget by $307,683. This is aggregate audited financial context; it does not provide individual deliveries, gallons, invoices, receipts or the final delivery date.

name: 2012 Road Commission–City Plett Road Project Agreement.pdf
description: Two-page agreement form dated July 16, 2012 in its source filename and PDF metadata. It states that the Road Commission designed and would construct the Plett Road/13th Street roundabout and box-culvert project, that plans and specifications were on file with the City, and that material changes required City approval. The supplied copy has blank date and signature lines, so it is preserved as an unsigned project record rather than proof of execution.

name: City of Cadillac April 2026 Flood News Release.pdf
description: April 24, 2026 City news release on post-flood conditions. It directs residents with flooded private wells to drinking-water sampling kits at the City laboratory, 1121 Plett Road, and reports that the observed flooding was associated mainly with lake and swamp conditions rather than a burst sanitary sewer, broken water main or damaged lift station. The release is emergency-response context, not a PFAS analytical result.

name: USGS 2012 Cadillac North Topographic Map.pdf
description: Official 2012 USGS Cadillac North 1:24,000 topographic GeoPDF showing regional relief, drainage, roads and the Clam River corridor in the Plett Road area. The map uses NAD83/WGS84 and UTM zone 16T. It is retained as regional topographic orientation and is not treated as a site-specific potentiometric surface or groundwater-flow map.

name: Proposed Resolution for the Plett Road and 13th Street Project.pdf
description: Three-page City resolution form for the proposed Road Commission–City Plett Road/13th Street roundabout and box-culvert agreement. The form names the August 6, 2012 meeting and a proposed $60,000 City contribution, but its resolution number, attendance, motion, vote and certification fields are blank. It is retained as a proposed form, not proof of approval or execution.

name: August 6 2012 Cadillac Council Packet — Road Commission and WWTP.pdf
description: Official August 6, 2012 Cadillac council packet containing the proposed Plett Road/13th Street resolution and unsigned agreement, the July 16 minutes recording denial of the earlier road-agreement motion, and a separate recommendation to replace a failed WWTP return-activated-sludge pump. The packet places both municipal subjects in one agenda but does not connect the road drainage work to the sanitary system or WWTP.

name: March 18 2019 Cadillac City Council Work Session Minutes.pdf
description: Official Cadillac budget work-session minutes stating that leachate revenue continued above budget but would end when the landfill's deep injection well went online. The minutes document the City's March 2019 expectation of a receiving change; they do not provide the exact final delivery date, gallons, manifests, invoices or WWTP receiving logs.

name: April 19 2017 Wexford County Board Minutes.pdf
description: Official Wexford County Board minutes. The record includes a discussion of transfer-station market context and American Waste's position on impact calculations under the solid-waste agreement. It is retained as governance context and contains no PFAS analytical result, dated landfill-to-WWTP load or source-to-receptor finding.

name: September 6 2017 Wexford County Board Minutes.pdf
description: Official Wexford County Board minutes recording discussion of the Solid Waste Agreement, including a stated $75,000 annual payment over ten years and the parties' benchmark calculation. The minutes are financial and governance context, not transaction-level leachate receiving evidence.

name: September 20 2017 Wexford County Board Minutes.pdf
description: Official Wexford County Board minutes containing board comments about the Solid Waste Agreement and American Waste. The record preserves contracting context but does not establish PFAS conditions, a specific leachate load or the timing of receiving cessation.

name: MPART Cadillac Industrial Park Area of Interest FAQ.pdf
description: January 2025 MPART FAQ for the Cadillac Industrial Park Area of Interest. It summarizes private-well response and filter eligibility, Cadillac and Haring public-water results, and the IPP PFAS history. Page 9 identifies Wexford County Landfill as Cadillac's industrial PFOS source and says the City ceased accepting landfill discharge in summer 2019; the FAQ does not state the exact final load date or quantity.

name: American Waste Inc Certificate of Amendment.pdf
description: Michigan LARA certificate of amendment for American Waste, Inc., filed July 15, 2019 under entity ID 800585556. The filing amends authorized capital and is retained for entity identity and date context; it is not treated as proof of a landfill asset transfer, leachate delivery or PFAS responsibility.

name: Wexford County Landfill LLC Articles of Organization.pdf
description: Michigan LARA articles of organization for Wexford County Landfill, LLC, filed June 13, 2011 under legacy ID D6168N and current entity ID 801614343. The filing establishes formation and registered-office information; it does not by itself establish ownership of a particular facility or contractual successor status.

name: Pescador LLC Articles of Organization.pdf
description: Michigan articles of organization for Pescador, L.L.C., filed October 21, 1999. The filing establishes formation and registered-office information only; any operational, contractual or ownership relationship must be supported by separate records.

name: Wexford Water Technologies LLC Articles of Organization.pdf
description: Michigan LARA articles of organization for Wexford Water Technologies, LLC, filed July 13, 2015 under legacy ID E6762L and current entity ID 801851167. The filing establishes formation and registered-office information; it does not prove an operating permit, injection-well authorization or facility transfer.

name: 2025-04-09 Wexford Self Sample AOI Maps.pdf
description: Six April 9, 2025 Wexford sampling-area maps distinguishing original self-sampled properties from proposed additional EGLE sampling around W 32 Road/Boon, east and west Lake Mitchell, Constitution Boulevard, S 45 Road and 13th/Plett Road. The maps document response planning; they do not establish completed sampling, analytical results or a PFAS migration pathway.

name: 2025-05-20 Sampling Questionnaire and Access Agreement - Public Redacted Copy.pdf
description: Public-release derivative of the signed May 20, 2025 EGLE sampling questionnaire and access agreement for 1140 Plett Road. Private names, contact information, owner details and the handwritten signature were permanently removed. The retained form records an irrigation well, no treatment, an untreated outdoor spigot and sampling-access instructions; authorization alone does not prove that sampling occurred or establish a PFAS pathway.
